newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B sinks 7.56 pct in midtrade.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B sinks 7.56 pct in midtrade.

text.p: MANILA, Aug 19 (Reuter) = Manila Electric Corp (Meralco) B shares suffered foreign selling in midtrade Monday falling nine pesos, or 7.56 percent at 110 pesos, brokers said.
"There's foreign selling and the issue is riding the wave of general selling in blue chips," said Jonathan Ravelas, head of sales at Asian Capital Equities.
Meralco B was the second most heavily traded issue with 102.63 million pesos worth of shares changing hands in midsession.
Meralco B shares are open to foreign and local investors while class A shares are exclusively for Filipinos.
Meralco A shares also shed one peso to 79.50 pesos in midsession.
